# remote

Manage the set of tracked repositories.

## remote

Manage the set of tracked repositories.

### JavaScript

```ts
git.remote()
```

### CLI

```bash
git --no-pager remote
```

### Parameters

_No parameters._

### Output

Parsed as `lines`. `result.data` is `string[]`. Configured remote names.

### Subcommands

- `remote.add` — Add a remote.
- `remote.remove` — Remove a remote.
- `remote.getUrl` — Print the URL of a remote.

## remote.add

Add a remote.

### JavaScript

```ts
git.remote.add({ fetch?: boolean, name: string, url: string })
```

### CLI

```bash
git --no-pager remote add [--fetch] <name> <url>
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | CLI | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fetch` | `--fetch` | `boolean` | No | - | Fetch the remote immediately. |
| `name` | _positional_ | `string` | Yes | - | Remote name. |
| `url` | _positional_ | `string` | Yes | - | Remote URL. |

### Examples

**Add an origin remote**

```ts
await git.remote.add({
  name: 'origin',
  url: 'https://example.com/repo.git',
})
```

```bash
git --no-pager remote add origin https://example.com/repo.git
```

## remote.remove

Remove a remote.

### JavaScript

```ts

```

### CLI

```bash
git --no-pager remote remove <name>
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | CLI | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | _positional_ | `string` | Yes | - | Remote name. |

## remote.getUrl

Print the URL of a remote.

### JavaScript

```ts
git.remote.getUrl({ name: string })
```

### CLI

```bash
git --no-pager remote get-url <name>
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | CLI | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | _positional_ | `string` | Yes | - | Remote name. |

### Output

Parsed as `custom`. `result.data` is `string`.
